chapter: Early life and the Whitney Bank
title: His parents' languages and a trip to Belize
summary: His mother spoke French and his father, William Dawson, a ship worker from British Honduras, Spanish; the family visited Belize for a month but left because of mosquitoes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
